text:
harper: Heads up — security researcher DM'd a fragment of a leaked tarball that appears to contain a private JWK used by our internal auth service `platform-auth`. Researcher flagged in #security-research. Treat as compromised; assume signing key exposure.

diego: can you paste the key id (kid)? which envs use it?

harper: kid: pa-kid-v1. Affected token issuer: auth.platform.redwood.internal. Primary impact: short-lived service JWTs used by connector services and a handful of CLI tooling that uses token-exchange. It looks limited to staging and the CLI beta, but we must rotate.

anya: I'll schedule immediate rotation window. Diego + I will: 1) publish new JWK set to the auth jwks endpoint; 2) update Vault path `secret/auth/platform/jwks` with new private key; 3) bump token-version header so older tokens are rejected; 4) restart auth pods. ETA 30m.

lloyd: what about existing tokens? any way to revoke?

diego: We can't revoke all existing JWTs unless they check a revocation list. Plan: add short-term mitigation: 1) start accepting only tokens with header `x-token-version: 2` or require introspection for tokens without that header; 2) push a lightweight revocation list to Redis for immediately blacklisting suspect token IDs we find in logs. Will instrument auth to check revocation list for old tokens for next 24h.

harper: good. Legal, heads-up in case of PII exposure?

legal: thanks. Send forensic copy to secure-case. If tokens were used to access customer data we escalate; otherwise this stays internal. Please tag case ID.

sec-bot: automation note: to rotate JWKs safely, you can use our `jwtctl` helper. Example: `jwtctl generate --kid pa-kid-v2 --out /tmp/pa-kid-v2.pem && jwtctl publish --service platform-auth --jwks /tmp/pa-kid-v2.pem --env staging`.

anya: executing now. Generated new key pair -> pa-kid-v2. Wrote private key to Vault: `vault kv put secret/auth/platform jwk=@/root/pa-kid-v2.pem kid=pa-kid-v2`. Pushed new JWKS endpoint, configured token-version to 2.

diego: rolling restart: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/platform-auth -n auth-staging` -> succeeded. Updated connector config: `CONFIG_AUTH_TOKEN_VERSION=2` and restarted connectors.

harper: update for audit please: paste commands you ran (I need this for the incident log). Also capture any token exchange logs with kid=pa-kid-v1 in the last 48h.

diego: commands run: `jwtctl generate --kid pa-kid-v2`, `vault kv put secret/auth/platform jwk=@/root/pa-kid-v2.pem kid=pa-kid-v2`, `kubectl rollout restart deploy/platform-auth -n auth-staging`. Cloud logs query run: found 7 token issuance events with kid=pa-kid-v1 in last 48h from two internal CI IPs; no external requests observed.

lloyd: added temporary auth middleware patch to require introspection for tokens with kid pa-kid-v1. Patch PR opened: infra/patches/auth-token-introspection.

harper: legal case created: SEC-CASE-2026-77. Forensics bundle path: secure-case/SEC-CASE-2026-77/artifacts. Diego, please add the Cloud logs extract there.

sec-bot: reminder checklist: update SDKs that ship embedded keys, notify CLI beta users to update, and add Snyk/GitHub secret ignore rules for example tarballs.

anya: queued a notification to beta-users@ and infra@ about CLI token reissue instructions. Also created follow-up tickets: MIGRATE-1042 (move all service auth to KMS-protected keys with hardware-backed generation), DEVX-2100 (scan published packages for embedded jwks).

harper: thanks team. We'll keep this thread as the action log. Reopen if audit finds external usage. :shield:
